Title: Document 5
Content: Overseas, our goal is ... to preserve a world at peace by keeping America strong. This philosophy once occupied a hallowed place in American diplomacy, but it was casually ... dismissed at the outset by the Carter Administration — and the results have been shattering. Never before in modern history has the United States endured as many humiliations, insults, and defeats as it has during the past `text(four years)`: our ambassadors murdered, our embassies burned, our warnings ignored, our diplomacy scorned, our diplomats kidnapped. The Carter Administration has shown that it neither understands totalitarianism nor appreciates the way tyrants take advantage of weakness. The brutal invasion of Afghanistan promises to be only the forerunner of much more serious threats to the West — and to world peace — should the Carter Administration somehow cling to power.
